entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. An official Hermes Agent provider, it is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This AGPL-3.0 context database utilizes a virtual filesystem and viking:// URIs to manage agent memory through tiered L0/L1/L2 loading. It is an official Hermes Agent provider that demonstrates significant token reduction and task-completion gains while offering observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine designed to give agents persistent long-term memory across sessions. It builds these graphs from text, code, and session data, supporting memory storage, retrieval, and distillation across various LLM providers.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain builds a knowledge graph with typed edges to store facts with provenance, allowing for corrections and memory withdrawal. It generates synthesized answers featuring citations and gap analysis to identify missing information.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent provider, this engine features a custom vector graph engine that supports sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication for prompt-cache discounts. It automates fact extraction and knowledge updates while offering connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides a learning-based memory system centered on retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term agent utility. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends via SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library serves as the foundation for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper, offering a reasoning-first approach that extracts conclusions from conversation history. It is implemented as a FastAPI server and supports managed hosting, local CLI execution, or Docker-based self-hosting.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Operating under the Elastic License 2.0, this official Hermes provider treats memory as a git repository with versioning for context tree management. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency system provides sub-millisecond memory for Hermes Agents using SQLite for local storage. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration with tools like Cursor and Claude Code, allowing facts to be stored with importance and expiry levels.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent memory and structured facts. It features an auto-curated wiki and a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness helps agents succeed on complex tasks by executing iterations to retain useful lessons and artifacts. It stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated promotion data in the filesystem, supporting Python, TypeScript, and MCP integrations.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost during agent operations. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from their history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This project indexes existing local session history from 25 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over gigabytes of past data. It allows agents to search months of previous sessions while redacting sensitive keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports persistence across any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference server via an automated setup script.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process to achieve high benchmark accuracy. It supports real-time ingestion from GitHub, Discord, and Obsidian to provide portable state across multiple agent clients.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur implements a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML files to ensure local ownership and transparency. It utilizes a hybrid search strategy combining BM25 and embeddings to provide local-first retrieval for MCP-compatible tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and coding agent hooks, utilizing hybrid BM25 and vector search to manage agent memory.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory offers a durable, file-based system that uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema instead of vector databases or embeddings. The architecture includes a specialized Hermes adapter and supports full-text search across Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency and token usage by reordering and deduplicating blocks for prefix reuse. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference with accuracy preservation.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching tags to every retrieved result to justify why it was selected. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It functions without a daemon or external databases, employing local embedding models for hybrid semantic and BM25 search.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver specific evidence packets to the agent for each query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs to populate a local-first cache. It is built as an MCP-native server using SQLite-vec and GGUF models for automated configuration with major coding clients.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts and rendered context files before the context window opens to reduce prompt token usage. It provides local-first persistence and session history tracking through MCP-native stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This provider implements reflective memory using edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes. It automates indexing for codebases and multimedia via OCR, utilizing a combination of BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages identity, decisions, and workflows for coding agents using plain Markdown files. It features a source-neutral migration workflow for documents and chats, supporting Claude Code, Codex, and other compatible agents.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories through 1-10 importance-weighted recall. It combines BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin focuses on data integrity by supporting real, immediate event deletion and providing a trace.jsonl audit log of all operations. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer and serves as a community fix for specific Hermes Agent recall issues.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables AI agents to settle payments directly to wallets across 37 chains, including EVM and Solana, with 0% fees. It allows agents to pay for API access while verifying transactions locally against the user's own RPC.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing to connect queries with skills, scripts, and MCP servers. It includes tools for neighbor traversal and automatically generates tool routing notes via model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo offers durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. The system ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox for searching and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin facilitates self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for grounded Q&A and file reads.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be deployed via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve agent state.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This project provides a file-based curation loop that manages agent memory through a git-backed directory of versioned markdown files. It uses specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, outputting evidence-cited diffs for manual review without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework utilizes a subagent-driven development process to execute tasks autonomously while enforcing test-driven development and YAGNI principles. It functions as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs, providing a structured methodology for agentic software development.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design system that supports 26 CLI executables, including Hermes, to generate web, mobile, and desktop prototypes with sandboxed previews. It enables agents to export projects into multiple formats such as HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agent operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts natural language, images, and infrastructure code like Terraform or Kubernetes into editable .drawio files. It allows agents to visualize codebase hierarchies and enforce architecture rules directly within CI/CD pipelines.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer to facilitate secure autonomous transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Compatible with Hermes and other agents, this tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It supports multiple operational modes, including rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library compatible with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It features a bilingual dashboard that allows users to inspect evolving skills and session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 14 metaskills that maintain state within a project's documentation folder. These skills are packaged as spec-conformant plugins for Claude Code and other industry-standard agent frameworks.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with export options available for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with various coding agents including Cursor and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed through integrated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries via Git and S3 sources using Pydantic AI. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set converts rough concepts into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full modes. It features a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models to manage project complexity.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to generate .lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It includes a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs source edits back to the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that utilizes SQLite and Git for local-first session storage. It implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol for supervised teams and uses Markdown-based recipes for prompt-first working methods.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configuration documentation specifically in Portuguese. All contributions follow the agentskills.io standard and are presented in the SKILL.md format.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable agent interaction with CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams via the Agent Skills specification. They are designed for discovery and activation within the Vercel open skills ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides official API integration skills for FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models. It includes a specialized router to direct requests to video generation agents and supports polling, webhooks, and error handling.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates agentskills.io-compliant skills by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits. it supports skill creation from code, documentation, and developer discourse with full lifecycle version management.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock is a registry for reusable AI skills that includes a Python client and a CLI for installation with recursive dependency resolution. It uniquely integrates commerce features using TON payments for skill transactions.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows as code using a .nika.yaml format and a Rust binary for local-first execution. It features a check command to audit task dependencies and estimate costs across different models.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill focuses on autonomous execution for complex, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of decisions. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for validating Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project employs a five-layer retrieval system, including FTS5 and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By reducing token usage and offering graceful degradation, it ensures efficient skill selection even when specific dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly personal execution system, this OS uses MCP connections for agent-driven scheduling and habit management. It stores data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces via a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on codebases. It combines deterministic scans from tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings produced in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various surfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a risk-tiered application process that requires an approval gate before making changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and evidence-based verification gates for complex task decomposition. It utilizes a Python goal engine for persistent state management and includes early-stop prevention for thorough debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding tools for developing new skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible README demonstration GIFs using vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering to markdown embedding while ensuring file sizes remain optimized under 8 MB.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: A local-first observability dashboard that provides real-time monitoring across 11 tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It maintains a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports incident alerts via Telegram or Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides immediate installation commands for discovered plugins and is compatible with clients like Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language descriptions while preventing specification rot. It includes a validator that checks skills against runtime-specific profiles and monitors official frontmatter specs for drift.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It uses a local evaluation framework involving LLM-judges and regression testing to gate all proposed updates.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills provide deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool ensures project-compatible runtimes are selected without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like x402 and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent standards for programmatic financial transactions.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the quality of agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to prove a skill works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: A plugin that allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with 85% of the payout going to the winning contributor.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms via an MCP server featuring 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Cursor, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and applies quality gates to its AI-driven analysis.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: A collection of Chinese-language utilities for video-to-text transcription, document OCR, and e-commerce material generation. It features a specialized engine to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns and processes Douyin links into Markdown and SRT formats.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary software binaries, offering a reliable way to manage development tool dependencies.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. It includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile operation.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It secures agent operations using AES-256-GCM encryption and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows users to build specific Hermes tags and ensures persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment uses systemd to run Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics using specialized LLM agents. It supports multiple providers, including Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and features automated risk management evaluation with decision-log memory.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for governing agent registration, task dispatch, and cost tracking. It provides multiple interfaces, including a Web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server, with deployment options via Docker or Node.js.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It utilizes tmux for persistent background sessions and includes container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A control room template that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals to manage paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board and live streams of reasoning. It implements human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena that orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes and Ollama on consumer GPUs. It utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered knowledge graph that indexes code symbols and callers to minimize token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It automatically updates the index upon file changes and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code relationships.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents and provides a Terminal User Interface for data visualization. Users can create profiles and submit their usage statistics to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from various coding agents while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the analysis of agent communication.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits across more than 35 AI coding tools. It synchronizes data across multiple devices and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, session, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with various agents and providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for application development. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project enables customization of the terminal UI through YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art to personalize their CLI experience.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel that operates without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for RL training and inference using vLLM and GGUF.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, supporting providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama. It features a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and an undo function for recent agent actions.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks and chat platforms using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports environments including LangGraph, CrewAI, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations, local memories, and specific skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local custom instructions and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs deterministic analysis of agent configurations and system prompts without requiring LLM or API calls. It identifies ambiguous tool descriptions and conflicting directives, supporting CI integration through SARIF output and baseline management.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transfers OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems via a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry. It features two-mode monitoring—passive analysis and active probing—to detect performance drift relative to local file changes without cloud dependencies.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project offers a deterministic, zero-network local runtime designed to help users generate revenue using Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for external actions and exposes its functionality through dynamic slash commands.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, wake-word-activated interaction to Hermes Agent across 35 languages. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities using Piper and Kokoro without requiring accounts or API keys.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This plugin integrates MemOS memory storage with Hermes, supporting semantic search and multi-dimensional storage. It includes dedicated tools for managing memories and a circuit breaker to handle potential MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a centralized interface for managing configurations across multiple tools, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It supports remote interaction via WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram, offering 21 professional assistants for document and presentation tasks.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for token monitoring and supports secure remote access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It includes a graphical user interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard supports multiple runtimes, including Hermes and Claude Code, with unified configuration for 10 platforms like WhatsApp and WeChat. It features a visual workflow builder that incorporates human approval gates and scheduled jobs.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a skills manager. It enables Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and utilizes tmux-backed workers for task execution.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents into a single collaborative workspace available as a desktop, server, or mobile client. The platform allows for the registration of any ACP-compatible agent and supports Docker deployments.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It features an embedded terminal for system repair alongside native views for Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a built-in kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat and memory management tasks.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes gateways. It features a Bot Mode for thread management and Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting across 31 writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from their phone by pairing with a webui server. It supports real-time streaming chat with attachments and provides mobile management for server files and cron jobs.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal user interface serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine interactive tabs and four color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard features a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It includes a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live API costs and quota burn for Codex and Claude. It builds local search indexes to query prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across agent histories without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent management.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It features a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This OpenTUI-based dashboard provides a text-based interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI allows users to manage up to five concurrent background agent instances via Telegram. It supports streaming terminal chat with file attachments and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop GUI requires no installation or admin rights, running via portable Python and Node.js environments. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supporting both local models via LM Studio and cloud models via OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface designed for real-time log streaming and chat with a self-hosted assistant. It features an integrated file browser, task tracking dashboard, and management tools for MCP servers and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time session activity and cost tracking for Hermes deployments. It allows for full inspection of skill source code and conversation histories alongside read-only environment variable monitoring.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace uses SSE streaming and tool approval cards to manage agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management for maintaining separate memories and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and includes a visual store for one-click skill installations. The interface supports model switching and provides streaming SSE responses during agent tasks.
